𝗧𝗬𝗣𝗛𝗢𝗢𝗡 𝗘𝗚𝗔𝗬 𝗟𝗘𝗔𝗩𝗘𝗦 𝟭 𝗗𝗘𝗔𝗗, 𝟮 𝗜𝗡𝗝𝗨𝗥𝗘𝗗 𝗜𝗡 𝗕𝗘𝗦𝗜𝗟, 𝗚𝗨𝗠𝗔𝗧𝗗𝗔𝗡𝗚
A landslide struck in Besil, Gumatdang, Itogon, around 8:00 PM on July 27, 2023, where two households were totally destroyed, leaving 1 dead and 2 injured.
Immediate response teams, including the Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council (MDRRMC), Municipal Health and Services Office (MHSO), Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP), Philippine National Police (PNP), and Barangay Gumatdang DRRMC, immediately responded to the incident and rescued three individuals. 
Among those injured were 36-year-old Bryner Balacdao and 35-year-old Maragaret Balacdao, who received on-site medical treatment.
The fatality was 59-year-old Derick Balacdao. The Itogon MDRRMC reported that he was found unconscious during the rescue operation and was immediately rushed to the Baguio General Hospital and Medical Center (BGHMC).
The Municipal Social Welfare and Development Office (MSWDO) reported eight houses destroyed and 69 others partially damaged, affecting 484 individuals. 22 individuals were evacuated and provided shelter in designated evacuation centers, while 49 sought temporary refuge with relatives.
Mayor Bernard S. Waclin activated the emergency operations center at the onset of heavy rains. The mayor dispatched responses to various incidents and ordered immediate relief operations to assist the victims and evacuees.

ROAD UPDATES: PROVINCIAL ROAD TO BUSCALAN AND SITIO SESEK-AN FROM TALALANG GOING TO BALBALASANG ROAD REMAIN UNPASSABLE

July 28, 2023 - The aftermath of Typhoon Egay is continuously monitored, especially the roads for mobilization. As recovery efforts are underway, two major roads remain closed due to severe damage, posing significant challenges to local communities and travelers.

The provincial road provincial road from Dananao junction to Tulgao -Butbut road leading to Buscalan, known for its renowned traditional tattoo artists and picturesque landscapes, is still not passable.

Fortunately, no reported accidents occurred and the power supply has been restored since 9:30 PM yesterday, July 27, 2023. However, there is an issue in their water supply due to partially damaged pipes at Buscalan and Sitio Canaan, Buscalan.

Furthermore, the Kalinga-Abra National Road, a vital thoroughfare connecting two provinces, is also currently NOT PASSABLE specifically in Sitio Sesek-an from Talalang going to Balbalasang which is near Abra province. The typhoon's impact has led to extensive damage to this major artery, making it unsafe for vehicular traffic.

In addition, MPS Balbalan has reported that there is still no electricity in the municipality.

Authorities have urged motorists to avoid the route until further notice to prevent accidents and to allow repair crews to carry out necessary restoration works.

properties.OTHERLAND:
Isa Patay, Ilan Sugatan sa Landslide sa Tuba, Benguet
Isang malagim na landslide ang naganap bandang alas-2:00 ng hapon noong Setyembre 22, 2025 sa Sitio Begis, Poblacion, Marcos Highway, Tuba, Benguet. Apat na sasakyan ang nadamay kabilang ang isang Ford Ranger, Toyota Innova, Toyota Grandia, at isang tanker truck.
Batay sa ulat, isang 74-anyos na lalaki mula Tarlac ang nasawi matapos maipit sa kanyang sasakyan. Idineklara siyang dead on arrival sa Baguio General Hospital and Medical Center (BGHMC).
Samantala, ilang pasahero na karamihan ay senior citizen mula Pasig City ang nagtamo ng mga sugat at pasa sa katawan. Kabilang dito ang apat na babae at isang lalaki na dinala sa BGHMC at kasalukuyang sumasailalim sa pagsusuri.
Sakay naman ng isang itim na van ang mag-asawang mula Baguio City. Habang ligtas ang driver, dinala sa Saint Louis University Hospital ang kanyang 36-anyos na asawa para sa masusing obserbasyon.
Sa isang tanker truck, nagtamo rin ng dislokasyon sa balikat at iba pang pinsala ang isang 40-anyos na driver na agad dinala sa ospital.

properties.OTHERINFO: LANDSLIDE SA RODRIGUEZ, RIZAL' Patay ang isang 37-anyos na ina habang sugatan ang kaniyang dalawang batang anak matapos silang mabagsakan ng dambuhalang bato mula sa gumuhong lupa sa Sitio Macopoy, Barangay Mascap, Rodriguez, Rizal, madaling-araw ng Linggo, Mayo 17. Sa ulat na natanggap ng PNP Police Regional Office 4A, kinilala ang nasawi na si Florisel Mahinay y Medina. Kasalukuyan namang ginagamot ang kaniyang mga anak na sina Miro, 2-anyos, at Jacob, 12-anyos. Ayon sa saksing anak na si Hazel, 18-anyos, nagising sila dakong alas-5:30 ng madaling-araw sa sigaw ng kanilang ina na, “Ano ‘yon, Parang may gumuguho, labas bilis labas!” Subalit ilang sandali lang, isang malaking bato ang gumulong mula sa bundok at direktang sumalpok sa kanilang bahay na nagdulot ng malubhang pinsala sa mga biktima. Isinugod ang mag-iina sa Casimiro A. Ynares Sr. Memorial Hospital, ngunit idineklarang dead on arrival si Florisel ng attending physician na si Dr. Kimberly Ann P. Pascual. Agad namang nilapatan ng first aid at patuloy na ginagamot ng mga staff ng ospital ang dalawang bata. 📸Bayan ng Montalban/FB

properties.OTHERINFO: KAIPILAN, CAMP 3 ROCK FALL A vehicle sustained damage after being hit by a falling rock in Sitio Kaipilan, Camp 3, Tuba, Benguet, at around 12:30 p.m. today, May 16. Police and barangay officials immediately responded to the incident, and no casualties or injuries were reported. The Tuba Municipal Police Station stated that the driver of the vehicle is a 54-year-old businessman and resident of Pangasinan. He was on his way to La Union when he noticed several rocks falling from the mountain. The driver stopped his vehicle, but a huge boulder rolled down the mountain and hit the front portion of his car. The Department of Public Works and Highways-Cordillera Administrative Region (DPWH-CAR) stated that the affected portion of the road remains one-lane passable. The public is advised to exercise caution while traveling. 📸 by Gaston Catalio Padua via Nover Basquial/Facebook

PAGGUHO NG MT. BALIKABOK SA ZAMBALES, TINITINGNANG UGAT NG FLASH FLOOD SA DINALUPIHAN TINITINGNANG UGAT NG MALAWAKANG FLASH FLOOD SA DINALUPIHAN, BATAAN, ANG MALAKIHANG PAGGUHO SA MT. BALIKABOK SA SUBIC, ZAMBALES. AYON SA INISYAL NA ASSESSMENT NG UP PROJECT NOAH AT MINES AND GEOSCIENCES BUREAU O MGB CENTRAL LUZON, MILYON-MILYONG CUBIC METERS NG LUPA, PUTIK, GRABA AT BATO ANG RUMAGASA SA MGA DRAINAGE AT RIVER SYSTEM PATUNGO SA MGA KOMUNIDAD SA DOWNSTREAM. DAHIL DITO, PATULOY ANG PAGTATASA SA PANGANIB SA ILANG BARANGAY SA DINALUPIHAN AT HERMOSA, BATAAN. AYON KAY BATAAN THIRD DISTRICT REPRESENTATIVE MARIA ANGELA GARCIA, KAILANGAN NG MAS MALALIM NA ASSESSMENT AT AGARANG HAKBANG UPANG MAPROTEKTAHAN ANG MGA KOMUNIDAD NA POSIBLENG MAAPEKTUHAN. SA UPDATED REPORT NINA PROFESSOR MAHAR LAGMAY AT JULIAN GRAGEDA NG UP RESILIENCE INSTITUTE AT NOAH CENTER, HINDI ORDINARYONG LANDSLIDE ANG NANGYARI SA MT. BALIKABOK. TINAWAG ITO NA “RAINFALL-TRIGGERED ROCKSLIDE–DEBRIS AVALANCHE–DEBRIS FLOW–FLOOD CASCADE.” BAGO ANG PAGGUHO NOONG AGOSTO TREYNTA, UMABOT SA 2,210.4 MILLIMETERS ANG NAITALANG ULAN SA ABUCAY PAGASA STATION NOONG AGOSTO. AYON SA ULAT, ITO AY MAHIGIT SAMPUNG BESES NG NAITALANG ULAN NOONG NAKARAANG TAON AT HALOS APAT AT KALAHATING BESES NG 2021 HANGGANG 2025 AVERAGE. PAGSAPIT NG AGOSTO BENTE-SIYETE, NASA 1,770 MILLIMETERS NA ANG NAIPONG ULAN. SINUNDAN PA ITO NG KARAGDAGANG 368.6 MILLIMETERS NG ULAN MULA AGOSTO BENTE-OTSO HANGGANG BENTE-NUWEBE. BAGAMA’T HINDI DIREKTANG NASUSUKAT SA MT. BALIKABOK ANG ULANG NAITALA SA ABUCAY PAGASA STATION, IPINAKIKITA NG MGA DATOS ANG MATINDING KONDISYON NG PAG-ULAN BAGO ANG MALAKIHANG PAGGUHO.
